```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
bin=$1
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/cat14_29-reference.XXXXXX)
cleanup() {
 if [ -f "$tmp/data/postmaster.pid" ]; then "$bin/pg_ctl" -D "$tmp/data" -m fast -w stop >/dev/null; fi
 test ! -f "$tmp/data/postmaster.pid"
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 echo 'cleanup: own reference cluster stopped and removed'
}
trap cleanup EXIT
"$bin/postgres" --version
"$bin/pg_config"
"$bin/psql" --version
python3 --version
"$bin/initdb" -D "$tmp/data" --no-locale --encoding=UTF8 --auth-local=trust --auth-host=reject > "$tmp/initdb.log"
"$bin/pg_ctl" -D "$tmp/data" -o "-k $tmp -h '' -p 56869" -l "$tmp/server.log" -w start >/dev/null
export REFERENCE_BIN="$bin" PGHOST="$tmp" PGPORT=56869 PGDATABASE=postgres
"$bin/psql" -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
SELECT version(); SHOW server_version_num; SHOW server_encoding;
CREATE ROLE cat14_29_reader LOGIN;
CREATE ROLE cat14_29_owner LOGIN;
GRANT USAGE,CREATE ON SCHEMA public TO cat14_29_owner;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO cat14_29_reader;
SET ROLE cat14_29_owner;
CREATE TABLE public.cat14_29_t(id integer);
INSERT INTO public.cat14_29_t VALUES(1);
GRANT SELECT ON public.cat14_29_t TO cat14_29_reader;
RESET ROLE;
SQL
python3 /tmp/cat14_29_reference_wire.py
```

```python
import socket,struct,os,json
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect(os.path.join(os.environ['PGHOST'],'.s.PGSQL.'+os.environ['PGPORT']))
def exact(n):
 b=b''
 while len(b)<n:
  part=s.recv(n-len(b))
  if not part: raise RuntimeError('EOF')
  b+=part
 return b
def read():
 tag=exact(1).decode();n=struct.unpack('!I',exact(4))[0];return tag,exact(n-4)
def send(tag,b):s.sendall(tag.encode()+struct.pack('!I',len(b)+4)+b)
def ready():
 out=[]
 while True:
  msg=read();out.append(msg)
  if msg[0]=='Z':return out
body=struct.pack('!I',196608)+"user\0cat14_29_reader\0database\0postgres\0\0".encode()
s.sendall(struct.pack('!I',len(body)+4)+body)
assert not any(t=='E' for t,b in ready())
def describe(b):
 n=struct.unpack('!h',b[:2])[0];out=[];i=2
 for _ in range(n):
  end=b.index(0,i);name=b[i:end].decode();i=end+1
  fields=struct.unpack('!IhIhih',b[i:i+18]);i+=18
  out.append(dict(zip(['name','source_oid','attribute','oid','typlen','typmod','format'],[name,*fields])))
 return out
def values(b):
 n=struct.unpack('!h',b[:2])[0];out=[];i=2
 for _ in range(n):
  size=struct.unpack('!i',b[i:i+4])[0];i+=4
  out.append(None if size<0 else b[i:i+size].hex());i+=max(size,0)
 return out

def summary(messages):
 return {'tags': ''.join(t for t,b in messages), 'descriptions':[describe(b) for t,b in messages if t=='T'], 'rows':[values(b) for t,b in messages if t=='D'], 'errors':[{part[:1].decode():part[1:].decode() for part in b.split(b'\0') if part} for t,b in messages if t=='E'], 'ready':[b.decode() for t,b in messages if t=='Z']}
def query(sql):
 send('Q',sql.encode()+b'\0');r=ready();print(sql,json.dumps(summary(r),ensure_ascii=False));return r


import subprocess
bin=os.environ['REFERENCE_BIN']
def admin(sql):
 subprocess.run([bin+'/psql','-X','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-U',os.environ.get('USER','xiangmin'),'-c',sql],check=True)
def rows(r): return [values(b) for t,b in r if t=='D']

def text_rows(r): return [[None if v is None else bytes.fromhex(v).decode() for v in row] for row in rows(r)]
def check(sql,expected):
 r=query(sql);assert text_rows(r)==expected,(sql,text_rows(r),expected);assert summary(r)['ready']==['I'];return r
def denied(sql,state,status='I'):
 r=query(sql);assert summary(r)['errors'][0]['C']==state;assert summary(r)['ready']==[status];assert not rows(r)


catalogs=[
 ('pg_foreign_data_wrapper','oid,fdwname,fdwowner,fdwhandler,fdwvalidator,fdwacl,fdwoptions','oid',2328,[26,19,26,26,26,1034,1009],[4,64,4,4,4,-1,-1]),
 ('pg_foreign_server','oid,srvname,srvowner,srvfdw,srvtype,srvversion,srvacl,srvoptions','oid',1417,[26,19,26,26,25,25,1034,1009],[4,64,4,4,-1,-1,-1,-1]),
 ('pg_foreign_table','ftrelid,ftserver,ftoptions','ftrelid',3118,[26,26,1009],[4,4,-1])]
for relation,columns,key,source,oids,lens in catalogs:
 base=f'SELECT {columns} FROM pg_catalog.{relation}'
 r=check(base,[])
 def metadata(r,fmt):

   assert [d[k] for k in ['source_oid','attribute','oid','typlen','typmod','format']]==[source,i+1,oids[i],lens[i],-1,fmt]
 metadata(r,0)
 prepared=base+f' WHERE {key}=$1::oid'
 send('P',b'space_stmt\0'+prepared.encode()+b'\0'+struct.pack('!hI',1,26));send('D',b'Sspace_stmt\0');send('S',b'');r=ready();print('statement',json.dumps(summary(r)));metadata(r,0)
 def execute(fmt):
  send('B',b'space_portal\0space_stmt\0'+struct.pack('!hh',0,1)+struct.pack('!i',1)+b'1'+struct.pack('!hh',1,fmt))
  send('D',b'Pspace_portal\0');send('E',b'space_portal\0'+struct.pack('!I',0));send('S',b'');r=ready();print('extended',fmt,json.dumps(summary(r)));return r
 for fmt in [0,1]:
  r=execute(fmt);assert not rows(r) and not summary(r)['errors'];metadata(r,fmt)
```

### Ready槽位与命令脚本

```text
#!/bin/bash
set -u
cd /Users/Shared/work/dir/data/codes/astersql-tidb || exit 1
mkdir -p target/rust-slot-locks
slot=''
for n in {1..10}; do
  if mkdir "target/rust-slot-locks/slot-$n.lock" 2>/dev/null; then slot="$n"; break; fi
done
if [ -z "$slot" ]; then exit 75; fi
lock="$PWD/target/rust-slot-locks/slot-$slot.lock"
printf 'plan=2026-10-29 catalog\ntask=30\nsession=task30-source-01a1b358-6462-7c81-bcf0-785ac0c85e35\npid=%s\n' "$$" > "$lock/holder"
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM
trap 'rm -f "$lock/holder"; rmdir "$lock"' EXIT
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$PWD/target/rust-slot-$slot"
printf 'SLOT=%s CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s\n' "$slot" "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR"
cargo fmt --all || exit $?
cargo fmt --all -- --check || exit $?
for test in \
 pg_catalog_test::cat14_30 \
 pg_session_test::cat14_30_policy_parser \
 pg_catalog_test::cat14_29 \
 pg_session_test::cat14_29_foreign_object_parser \
 pg_catalog_test::cat14_28 \
 pg_catalog_test::cat14_19 \
 pg_extended_test::pg_introspection_binary_results_and_recovery; do
  cargo test -p astersql-server --lib "$test" -- --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1 > "/tmp/cat14_30-ready-${test//::/_}.log" 2>&1
  code=$?
  printf '%s EXIT=%s\n' "$test" "$code"
  if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then tail -n 24 "/tmp/cat14_30-ready-${test//::/_}.log"; exit "$code"; fi
done
make lint > /tmp/cat14_30-lint.log 2>&1
code=$?
printf 'make lint EXIT=%s\n' "$code"
exit "$code"
```

```text
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
bin=$1
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/cat14_30-reference.XXXXXX)
cleanup() {
 if [ -f "$tmp/data/postmaster.pid" ]; then "$bin/pg_ctl" -D "$tmp/data" -m fast -w stop >/dev/null; fi
 test ! -f "$tmp/data/postmaster.pid"
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 echo 'cleanup: own reference cluster stopped and removed'
}
trap cleanup EXIT
"$bin/postgres" --version
"$bin/pg_config"
"$bin/psql" --version
python3 --version
"$bin/initdb" -D "$tmp/data" --no-locale --encoding=UTF8 --auth-local=trust --auth-host=reject > "$tmp/initdb.log"
"$bin/pg_ctl" -D "$tmp/data" -o "-k $tmp -h '' -p 56870" -l "$tmp/server.log" -w start >/dev/null
export REFERENCE_BIN="$bin" PGHOST="$tmp" PGPORT=56870 PGDATABASE=postgres
"$bin/psql" -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
SELECT version(); SHOW server_version_num; SHOW server_encoding;
CREATE ROLE cat14_30_reader LOGIN;
CREATE ROLE cat14_30_owner LOGIN;

GRANT SELECT ON public.cat14_30_t TO cat14_30_reader;
RESET ROLE;
SQL
```

```text
import socket,struct,os,json
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect(os.path.join(os.environ['PGHOST'],'.s.PGSQL.'+os.environ['PGPORT']))
def exact(n):
 b=b''
 while len(b)<n:
  part=s.recv(n-len(b))
  if not part: raise RuntimeError('EOF')
  b+=part
 return b
def read():
 tag=exact(1).decode();n=struct.unpack('!I',exact(4))[0];return tag,exact(n-4)
def send(tag,b):s.sendall(tag.encode()+struct.pack('!I',len(b)+4)+b)
def ready():
 out=[]
 while True:
  msg=read();out.append(msg)
  if msg[0]=='Z':return out
body=struct.pack('!I',196608)+"user\0cat14_30_reader\0database\0postgres\0\0".encode()
s.sendall(struct.pack('!I',len(body)+4)+body)
assert not any(t=='E' for t,b in ready())
def describe(b):
 n=struct.unpack('!h',b[:2])[0];out=[];i=2
 for _ in range(n):
  end=b.index(0,i);name=b[i:end].decode();i=end+1
  fields=struct.unpack('!IhIhih',b[i:i+18]);i+=18
  out.append(dict(zip(['name','source_oid','attribute','oid','typlen','typmod','format'],[name,*fields])))
 return out
def values(b):
 n=struct.unpack('!h',b[:2])[0];out=[];i=2
 for _ in range(n):
  size=struct.unpack('!i',b[i:i+4])[0];i+=4
  out.append(None if size<0 else b[i:i+size].hex());i+=max(size,0)
 return out

def summary(messages):
 return {'tags': ''.join(t for t,b in messages), 'descriptions':[describe(b) for t,b in messages if t=='T'], 'rows':[values(b) for t,b in messages if t=='D'], 'errors':[{part[:1].decode():part[1:].decode() for part in b.split(b'\0') if part} for t,b in messages if t=='E'], 'ready':[b.decode() for t,b in messages if t=='Z']}
def query(sql):
 send('Q',sql.encode()+b'\0');r=ready();print(sql,json.dumps(summary(r),ensure_ascii=False));return r


import subprocess
bin=os.environ['REFERENCE_BIN']
def admin(sql):
 subprocess.run([bin+'/psql','-X','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-U',os.environ.get('USER','xiangmin'),'-c',sql],check=True)
def rows(r): return [values(b) for t,b in r if t=='D']

def text_rows(r): return [[None if v is None else bytes.fromhex(v).decode() for v in row] for row in rows(r)]
def check(sql,expected):
 r=query(sql);assert text_rows(r)==expected,(sql,text_rows(r),expected);assert summary(r)['ready']==['I'];return r
def denied(sql,state,status='I'):
 r=query(sql);assert summary(r)['errors'][0]['C']==state;assert summary(r)['ready']==[status];assert not rows(r)


catalogs=[('pg_policy','oid,polname,polrelid,polpermissive,polroles,polcmd,polqual,polwithcheck','oid',3256,[26,19,26,16,1028,18,194,194],[4,64,4,1,-1,1,-1,-1])]
for relation,columns,key,source,oids,lens in catalogs:
 base=f'SELECT {columns} FROM pg_catalog.{relation}'
 r=check(base,[])
 def metadata(r,fmt):
  for i,d in enumerate(summary(r)['descriptions'][0]):
   assert [d[k] for k in ['source_oid','attribute','oid','typlen','typmod','format']]==[source,[1,2,3,5,6,4,7,8][i],oids[i],lens[i],-1,fmt]
 metadata(r,0)
 prepared=base+f' WHERE {key}=$1::oid'
 send('P',b'space_stmt\0'+prepared.encode()+b'\0'+struct.pack('!hI',1,26));send('D',b'Sspace_stmt\0');send('S',b'');r=ready();print('statement',json.dumps(summary(r)));metadata(r,0)
 def execute(fmt):
  send('B',b'space_portal\0space_stmt\0'+struct.pack('!hh',0,1)+struct.pack('!i',1)+b'1'+struct.pack('!hh',1,fmt))
  send('D',b'Pspace_portal\0');send('E',b'space_portal\0'+struct.pack('!I',0));send('S',b'');r=ready();print('extended',fmt,json.dumps(summary(r)));return r
 for fmt in [0,1]:
  r=execute(fmt);assert not rows(r) and not summary(r)['errors'];metadata(r,fmt)
  send('C',b'Pspace_portal\0');send('S',b'');ready()
 denied(f'SELECT absent_field FROM pg_catalog.{relation} LIMIT 0','42703');check('SELECT 1',[['1']])
 admin(f'REVOKE SELECT ON pg_catalog.{relation} FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE SELECT ON pg_catalog.{relation} FROM cat14_30_reader')
 denied(base,'42501');denied(base+' LIMIT 0','42501')
 r=execute(1);assert summary(r)['errors'][0]['C']=='42501';assert summary(r)['ready']==['I']
 query('BEGIN');denied(base,'42501','E');denied('SELECT 1','25P02','E');query('ROLLBACK');check('SELECT 1',[['1']])
 admin(f'GRANT SELECT ON pg_catalog.{relation} TO cat14_30_reader')
 r=execute(1);assert not summary(r)['errors'] and not rows(r);metadata(r,1)
 send('C',b'Pspace_portal\0');send('C',b'Sspace_stmt\0');send('S',b'');ready()
 admin(f'REVOKE SELECT ON pg_catalog.{relation} FROM cat14_30_reader; GRANT SELECT ON pg_catalog.{relation} TO PUBLIC')
join="SELECT c.relname,p.oid,p.polname,p.polrelid,p.polpermissive,p.polroles,p.polcmd,p.polqual,p.polwithcheck FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_policy p ON c.oid=p.polrelid WHERE c.relname='cat14_30_t'"
check(join,[['cat14_30_t']+[None]*8])
send('P',b'null_stmt\0'+join.encode()+b'\0'+struct.pack('!h',0));send('B',b'null_portal\0null_stmt\0'+struct.pack('!hhhh',0,0,1,1));send('D',b'Pnull_portal\0');send('E',b'null_portal\0'+struct.pack('!I',0));send('S',b'');r=ready();print('binary LEFT JOIN',json.dumps(summary(r)));assert text_rows(r)==[['cat14_30_t']+[None]*8]
send('C',b'Pnull_portal\0');send('C',b'Snull_stmt\0');send('S',b'');ready()
# Real PostgreSQL supports RLS: enabled with zero policies denies rows. Catalog
# emptiness by itself never establishes that RLS is disabled.
admin('ALTER TABLE public.cat14_30_t ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY')
check("SELECT relrowsecurity,relforcerowsecurity FROM pg_class WHERE relname='cat14_30_t'",[['t','f']])
check('SELECT oid FROM pg_policy',[])
check('SELECT id FROM public.cat14_30_t',[])
admin("SET ROLE cat14_30_owner; CREATE POLICY cat14_30_p ON public.cat14_30_t FOR SELECT TO cat14_30_reader USING (id=1)")
r=query("SELECT polname,polrelid,polpermissive,polroles,polcmd,polqual,polwithcheck FROM pg_policy")
assert len(rows(r))==1 and text_rows(r)[0][0]=='cat14_30_p' and text_rows(r)[0][-1] is None
check('SELECT id FROM public.cat14_30_t',[['1']])
admin('SET ROLE cat14_30_owner; DROP POLICY cat14_30_p ON public.cat14_30_t; ALTER TABLE public.cat14_30_t DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY')
check('SELECT id FROM public.cat14_30_t',[['1']])
send('X',b'');s.close();print('cat14_30 reference passed: 8 fields, text/binary, NULL join, ACL and I/T/E recovery, enabled RLS with zero policy denies, policy permits, cleanup')
```

## 任务31：触发器必需事实门禁（ABS-TRIGGER）

状态：已完成（2026-11-07，批次31）。实施提交：`5f4ce79184eabf28c0dc5adaa9eb047ae6f4d2b2`（fix(postgresql): gate missing foreign key trigger facts）；实施前完整HEAD：`6470e2a1afc060effef4d8fb9b58c6fcde8fd8b7`。已阅读批次1保留证据，`git merge-base --is-ancestor 769983be19560daaf3c485f762f67a9f7c0a7c41 HEAD`退出0，未把编号文件删除当完成。plan.md只读、无差异，SHA256仍为`3b314c2b6914665de82a6be9319b8797375c2088b2d14deae0fbd1dac7414edd`。

使用do-task-plans、仓库rustcodegraph及git-commit技能，无派生代理。已读根/server AGENTS、PLANS、DDL README、testing-flow和notes-guide，server无doc.go。RustCodeGraph status显示11933文件/359442节点，使用explore/node查阅当前目录入口和共享FK事实。DDL入口首次发现未门禁时暂记阻塞；主会话随后转达用户明确补充授权，允许任务31不可缺少的最小SessionQuery接线，故解除阻塞续跑，未建设触发器执行子系统。

### 文件与局部接线依据

- `pkg/server/pg_catalog.rs`：补pg_trigger五列类型、来源OID2620和物理属性；未知列42703。将其从无条件空provider拆出，复用Execution单次schema快照、当前库模型与连接临时模型，模型含ForeignKeys时输出前0A000。缺元数据/快照同样拒绝，不虚构触发器/函数身份。此修改直接对应ABS-TRIGGER的“已开放FK时不能以空集宣称完整内省”。
- `pkg/server/pg_session.rs`：复用已有有界PG lexer、POLICY/RLS前置拒绝扫描器，补CREATE [OR REPLACE] [CONSTRAINT] TRIGGER、ALTER/DROP TRIGGER与ALTER TABLE ENABLE [ALWAYS|REPLICA]/DISABLE TRIGGER的副作用前0A000。顶层复合ALTER在任何前序action执行前整体拒绝。此项为用户续跑授权的不可缺少局部接线，确保目录无用户触发器的空集依据可成立；不创建对象、函数或触发器引擎。
- `pkg/server/pg_catalog_test.rs::cat14_31`：真实Domain/KV、ConcreteSessionDriver、PgService、非root owner/reader连接；服务/数据库/角色与对象均使用专属名字，并在异常路径Drop清理。原生RENAME计划器要求旧表ALTER/DROP、目标表CREATE/INSERT，管理员显式授予这四项原生权限供生命周期夹具，未修改生产授权子系统，不声称完整PG owner DDL桥接。
- `pkg/server/pg_session_test.rs::cat14_31_trigger_parser`：12类拒绝输入与7类名称/注释/字符串/GRANT TRIGGER误拒绝边界。
- 两个对应`.rs.md`同步能力、错误和保守范围，docs-manifest已包含映射，无新增生产文件。AsterSQL版权标记保留，无Go/Bazel/Cargo manifest或外部依赖变更，无本地patch/vendor副本。

### 任务31 参考启动与清理脚本

```text
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
bin=$1
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/cat14_31-reference.XXXXXX)
cleanup() {
 if [ -f "$tmp/data/postmaster.pid" ]; then "$bin/pg_ctl" -D "$tmp/data" -m fast -w stop >/dev/null; fi
 test ! -f "$tmp/data/postmaster.pid"
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 echo 'cleanup: own reference cluster stopped and removed'
}
trap cleanup EXIT
"$bin/postgres" --version
"$bin/pg_config"
"$bin/psql" --version
python3 --version
"$bin/initdb" -D "$tmp/data" --no-locale --encoding=UTF8 --auth-local=trust --auth-host=reject > "$tmp/initdb.log"
"$bin/pg_ctl" -D "$tmp/data" -o "-k $tmp -h '' -p 56871" -l "$tmp/server.log" -w start >/dev/null
export REFERENCE_BIN="$bin" PGHOST="$tmp" PGPORT=56871 PGDATABASE=postgres
"$bin/psql" -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
SELECT version(); SHOW server_version_num; SHOW server_encoding;
CREATE ROLE cat14_31_reader LOGIN;
CREATE ROLE cat14_31_owner LOGIN;
GRANT USAGE,CREATE ON SCHEMA public TO cat14_31_owner;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO cat14_31_reader;
SET ROLE cat14_31_owner;
CREATE TABLE public.cat14_31_t(id integer);
INSERT INTO public.cat14_31_t VALUES(1);
GRANT SELECT ON public.cat14_31_t TO cat14_31_reader;
RESET ROLE;
SQL
python3 /tmp/cat14_31_reference_wire.py
```

```text
import socket,struct,os,json
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect(os.path.join(os.environ['PGHOST'],'.s.PGSQL.'+os.environ['PGPORT']))
def exact(n):
 b=b''
 while len(b)<n:
  part=s.recv(n-len(b))
  if not part: raise RuntimeError('EOF')
  b+=part
 return b
def read():
 tag=exact(1).decode();n=struct.unpack('!I',exact(4))[0];return tag,exact(n-4)
def send(tag,b):s.sendall(tag.encode()+struct.pack('!I',len(b)+4)+b)
def ready():
 out=[]
 while True:
  msg=read();out.append(msg)
  if msg[0]=='Z':return out
body=struct.pack('!I',196608)+"user\0cat14_31_reader\0database\0postgres\0\0".encode()
s.sendall(struct.pack('!I',len(body)+4)+body)
assert not any(t=='E' for t,b in ready())
def describe(b):
 n=struct.unpack('!h',b[:2])[0];out=[];i=2
 for _ in range(n):
  end=b.index(0,i);name=b[i:end].decode();i=end+1
  fields=struct.unpack('!IhIhih',b[i:i+18]);i+=18
  out.append(dict(zip(['name','source_oid','attribute','oid','typlen','typmod','format'],[name,*fields])))
 return out
def values(b):
 n=struct.unpack('!h',b[:2])[0];out=[];i=2
 for _ in range(n):
  size=struct.unpack('!i',b[i:i+4])[0];i+=4
  out.append(None if size<0 else b[i:i+size].hex());i+=max(size,0)
 return out

def summary(messages):
 return {'tags': ''.join(t for t,b in messages), 'descriptions':[describe(b) for t,b in messages if t=='T'], 'rows':[values(b) for t,b in messages if t=='D'], 'errors':[{part[:1].decode():part[1:].decode() for part in b.split(b'\0') if part} for t,b in messages if t=='E'], 'ready':[b.decode() for t,b in messages if t=='Z']}
def query(sql):
 send('Q',sql.encode()+b'\0');r=ready();print(sql,json.dumps(summary(r),ensure_ascii=False));return r


import subprocess
bin=os.environ['REFERENCE_BIN']
def admin(sql):
 subprocess.run([bin+'/psql','-X','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-U',os.environ.get('USER','xiangmin'),'-c',sql],check=True)
def rows(r): return [values(b) for t,b in r if t=='D']

def text_rows(r): return [[None if v is None else bytes.fromhex(v).decode() for v in row] for row in rows(r)]
def check(sql,expected):
 r=query(sql);assert text_rows(r)==expected,(sql,text_rows(r),expected);assert summary(r)['ready']==['I'];return r
def denied(sql,state,status='I'):
 r=query(sql);assert summary(r)['errors'][0]['C']==state;assert summary(r)['ready']==[status];assert not rows(r)



sql='SELECT oid,tgrelid,tgname,tgfoid,tgisinternal FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger ORDER BY oid'
r=check(sql,[])
desc=summary(r)['descriptions'][0]
assert [(d['oid'],d['typlen'],d['typmod'],d['source_oid'],d['attribute']) for d in desc]==[(26,4,-1,2620,1),(26,4,-1,2620,2),(19,64,-1,2620,4),(26,4,-1,2620,5),(16,1,-1,2620,8)]
join="SELECT c.relname,t.oid,t.tgrelid,t.tgname,t.tgfoid,t.tgisinternal FROM pg_class c LEFT JOIN pg_trigger t ON c.oid=t.tgrelid WHERE c.relname='cat14_31_t'"
check(join,[['cat14_31_t',None,None,None,None,None]])
prepared='SELECT oid,tgrelid,tgname,tgfoid,tgisinternal FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid=$1::oid'
send('P',b'trig\0'+prepared.encode()+b'\0'+struct.pack('!hI',1,26));send('D',b'Strig\0');send('S',b'');print('Parse/Describe',json.dumps(summary(ready())))
for fmt in [0,1]:
 send('B',b'p\0trig\0'+struct.pack('!hhi',0,1,-1)+struct.pack('!hh',1,fmt));send('D',b'Pp\0');send('E',b'p\0'+struct.pack('!i',0));send('S',b'');r=ready();print('NULL parameter',json.dumps(summary(r)));assert not rows(r)
 send('C',b'Pp\0');send('S',b'');ready()
for fmt in [0,1]:
 send('P',b'j\0'+join.encode()+b'\0'+struct.pack('!h',0));send('B',b'jp\0j\0'+struct.pack('!hhh',0,0,1)+struct.pack('!h',fmt));send('D',b'Pjp\0');send('E',b'jp\0'+struct.pack('!i',0));send('S',b'');r=ready();print('LEFT JOIN',json.dumps(summary(r)));assert text_rows(r)==[['cat14_31_t',None,None,None,None,None]]
 send('C',b'Pjp\0');send('C',b'Sj\0');send('S',b'');ready()
denied('SELECT missing_column FROM pg_trigger LIMIT 0','42703');check('SELECT 1',[['1']])
```

```text
import socket,struct,os,json
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect(os.path.join(os.environ['PGHOST'],'.s.PGSQL.'+os.environ['PGPORT']))
def exact(n):
 b=b''
 while len(b)<n:
  part=s.recv(n-len(b))
  if not part: raise RuntimeError('EOF')
  b+=part
 return b
def read():
 tag=exact(1).decode();n=struct.unpack('!I',exact(4))[0];return tag,exact(n-4)
def send(tag,b):s.sendall(tag.encode()+struct.pack('!I',len(b)+4)+b)
def ready():
 out=[]
 while True:
  msg=read();out.append(msg)
  if msg[0]=='Z':return out
body=struct.pack('!I',196608)+"user\0cat14_32_reader\0database\0postgres\0\0".encode()
s.sendall(struct.pack('!I',len(body)+4)+body)
assert not any(t=='E' for t,b in ready())
def describe(b):
 n=struct.unpack('!h',b[:2])[0];out=[];i=2
 for _ in range(n):
  end=b.index(0,i);name=b[i:end].decode();i=end+1
  fields=struct.unpack('!IhIhih',b[i:i+18]);i+=18
  out.append(dict(zip(['name','source_oid','attribute','oid','typlen','typmod','format'],[name,*fields])))
 return out
def values(b):
 n=struct.unpack('!h',b[:2])[0];out=[];i=2
 for _ in range(n):
  size=struct.unpack('!i',b[i:i+4])[0];i+=4
  out.append(None if size<0 else b[i:i+size].hex());i+=max(size,0)
 return out

def summary(messages):
 return {'tags': ''.join(t for t,b in messages), 'descriptions':[describe(b) for t,b in messages if t=='T'], 'rows':[values(b) for t,b in messages if t=='D'], 'errors':[{part[:1].decode():part[1:].decode() for part in b.split(b'\0') if part} for t,b in messages if t=='E'], 'ready':[b.decode() for t,b in messages if t=='Z']}
def query(sql):
 send('Q',sql.encode()+b'\0');r=ready();print(sql,json.dumps(summary(r),ensure_ascii=False));return r

bin=os.environ['REFERENCE_BIN']
def admin(sql):
 subprocess.run([bin+'/psql','-X','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-U',os.environ.get('USER','xiangmin'),'-c',sql],check=True)
def rows(r): return [values(b) for t,b in r if t=='D']

def text_rows(r): return [[None if v is None else bytes.fromhex(v).decode() for v in row] for row in rows(r)]

 r=query(sql);assert text_rows(r)==expected,(sql,text_rows(r),expected);assert summary(r)['ready']==['I'];return r
def denied(sql,state,status='I'):
```

```text
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
bin=$1
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/cat14_33-reference.XXXXXX)
cleanup() {
 if [ -f "$tmp/data/postmaster.pid" ]; then "$bin/pg_ctl" -D "$tmp/data" -m fast -w stop >/dev/null; fi
 test ! -f "$tmp/data/postmaster.pid"
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 echo 'cleanup: own reference cluster stopped and removed'
}
trap cleanup EXIT
"$bin/postgres" --version
"$bin/pg_config"
"$bin/psql" --version
python3 --version
"$bin/initdb" -D "$tmp/data" --no-locale --encoding=UTF8 --auth-local=trust --auth-host=reject > "$tmp/initdb.log"
"$bin/pg_ctl" -D "$tmp/data" -o "-k $tmp -h '' -p 56873" -l "$tmp/server.log" -w start >/dev/null
export REFERENCE_BIN="$bin" PGHOST="$tmp" PGPORT=56873 PGDATABASE=postgres
"$bin/psql" -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
SELECT version(); SHOW server_version_num; SHOW server_encoding;
CREATE ROLE cat14_33_reader LOGIN;
CREATE ROLE cat14_33_owner LOGIN;
GRANT USAGE,CREATE ON SCHEMA public TO cat14_33_owner;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO cat14_33_reader;
SET ROLE cat14_33_owner;
CREATE TABLE public.cat14_33_t(id integer);
INSERT INTO public.cat14_33_t VALUES(1);
GRANT SELECT ON public.cat14_33_t TO cat14_33_reader;
RESET ROLE;
SQL
python3 /tmp/cat14_33_reference_wire.py
```

```text
import socket,struct,os,json
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect(os.path.join(os.environ['PGHOST'],'.s.PGSQL.'+os.environ['PGPORT']))
def exact(n):
 b=b''
 while len(b)<n:
  part=s.recv(n-len(b))
  if not part: raise RuntimeError('EOF')
  b+=part
 return b
def read():
 tag=exact(1).decode();n=struct.unpack('!I',exact(4))[0];return tag,exact(n-4)
def send(tag,b):s.sendall(tag.encode()+struct.pack('!I',len(b)+4)+b)
def ready():
 out=[]
 while True:
  msg=read();out.append(msg)
  if msg[0]=='Z':return out
body=struct.pack('!I',196608)+"user\0cat14_33_reader\0database\0postgres\0\0".encode()
s.sendall(struct.pack('!I',len(body)+4)+body)
assert not any(t=='E' for t,b in ready())
def describe(b):
 n=struct.unpack('!h',b[:2])[0];out=[];i=2
 for _ in range(n):
  end=b.index(0,i);name=b[i:end].decode();i=end+1
  fields=struct.unpack('!IhIhih',b[i:i+18]);i+=18
  out.append(dict(zip(['name','source_oid','attribute','oid','typlen','typmod','format'],[name,*fields])))
 return out
def values(b):
 n=struct.unpack('!h',b[:2])[0];out=[];i=2
 for _ in range(n):
  size=struct.unpack('!i',b[i:i+4])[0];i+=4
  out.append(None if size<0 else b[i:i+size].hex());i+=max(size,0)
 return out

def summary(messages):
 return {'tags': ''.join(t for t,b in messages), 'descriptions':[describe(b) for t,b in messages if t=='T'], 'rows':[values(b) for t,b in messages if t=='D'], 'errors':[{part[:1].decode():part[1:].decode() for part in b.split(b'\0') if part} for t,b in messages if t=='E'], 'ready':[b.decode() for t,b in messages if t=='Z']}
def query(sql):
 send('Q',sql.encode()+b'\0');r=ready();print(sql,json.dumps(summary(r),ensure_ascii=False));return r


import subprocess
bin=os.environ['REFERENCE_BIN']
def admin(sql):
 subprocess.run([bin+'/psql','-X','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-U',os.environ.get('USER','xiangmin'),'-c',sql],check=True)
def rows(r): return [values(b) for t,b in r if t=='D']

def text_rows(r): return [[None if v is None else bytes.fromhex(v).decode() for v in row] for row in rows(r)]
def check(sql,expected):
 r=query(sql);assert text_rows(r)==expected,(sql,text_rows(r),expected);assert summary(r)['ready']==['I'];return r
def denied(sql,state,status='I'):
 r=query(sql);assert summary(r)['errors'][0]['C']==state;assert summary(r)['ready']==[status];assert not rows(r)
```

#### 可恢复脚本/实采：cat14_34-stage.sh

```text
#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail
mkdir -p target/rust-slot-locks
slot=""
for n in {1..10}; do
 if mkdir "target/rust-slot-locks/slot-$n.lock" 2>/dev/null; then slot=$n; break; fi
done
if [ -z "$slot" ]; then echo 'all slots occupied'; exit 75; fi
lock="$PWD/target/rust-slot-locks/slot-$slot.lock"
printf 'plan=catalog14 task=34 session=cat14_34 PID=%s\n' "$$" > "$lock/owner"
trap 'rm -f "$lock/owner"; rmdir "$lock"' EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$PWD/target/rust-slot-$slot"
echo "slot=$slot CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$CARGO_TARGET_DIR PID=$$"
"$@"
result=$?
echo "exit=$result"
exit "$result"
```

```text
import socket,struct,os,json
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect(os.path.join(os.environ['PGHOST'],'.s.PGSQL.'+os.environ['PGPORT']))
def exact(n):
 b=b''
 while len(b)<n:
  part=s.recv(n-len(b))
  if not part: raise RuntimeError('EOF')
  b+=part
 return b
def read():
 tag=exact(1).decode();n=struct.unpack('!I',exact(4))[0];return tag,exact(n-4)
def send(tag,b):s.sendall(tag.encode()+struct.pack('!I',len(b)+4)+b)
def ready():
 out=[]
 while True:
  msg=read();out.append(msg)
  if msg[0]=='Z':return out
body=struct.pack('!I',196608)+"user\0cat14_34_reader\0database\0postgres\0\0".encode()
s.sendall(struct.pack('!I',len(body)+4)+body)
assert not any(t=='E' for t,b in ready())
def describe(b):
 n=struct.unpack('!h',b[:2])[0];out=[];i=2
 for _ in range(n):
  end=b.index(0,i);name=b[i:end].decode();i=end+1
  fields=struct.unpack('!IhIhih',b[i:i+18]);i+=18
  out.append(dict(zip(['name','source_oid','attribute','oid','typlen','typmod','format'],[name,*fields])))
 return out
def values(b):
 n=struct.unpack('!h',b[:2])[0];out=[];i=2
 for _ in range(n):
  size=struct.unpack('!i',b[i:i+4])[0];i+=4
  out.append(None if size<0 else b[i:i+size].hex());i+=max(size,0)
 return out

def summary(messages):
 return {'tags': ''.join(t for t,b in messages), 'descriptions':[describe(b) for t,b in messages if t=='T'], 'rows':[values(b) for t,b in messages if t=='D'], 'errors':[{part[:1].decode():part[1:].decode() for part in b.split(b'\0') if part} for t,b in messages if t=='E'], 'ready':[b.decode() for t,b in messages if t=='Z']}
def query(sql):
 send('Q',sql.encode()+b'\0');r=ready();print(sql,json.dumps(summary(r),ensure_ascii=False));return r


import subprocess
bin=os.environ['REFERENCE_BIN']
def admin(sql):
 subprocess.run([bin+'/psql','-X','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-U',os.environ.get('USER','xiangmin'),'-c',sql],check=True)
def rows(r): return [values(b) for t,b in r if t=='D']

def text_rows(r): return [[None if v is None else bytes.fromhex(v).decode() for v in row] for row in rows(r)]
def check(sql,expected):
 r=query(sql);assert text_rows(r)==expected,(sql,text_rows(r),expected);assert summary(r)['ready']==['I'];return r
def denied(sql,state,status='I'):
 r=query(sql);assert summary(r)['errors'][0]['C']==state;assert summary(r)['ready']==[status];assert not rows(r)




for relation,name,builtin,columns,oids,attrs in [
 ('pg_opfamily','opfname','integer_ops','oid,opfname,opfmethod,opfowner,opfnamespace',[26,19,26,26,26],[1,3,2,5,4]),
 ('pg_opclass','opcname','int4_ops','oid,opcname,opcmethod,opcintype,opckeytype,opcdefault,opcfamily,opcowner,opcnamespace',[26,19,26,26,26,16,26,26,26],[1,3,2,7,9,8,6,5,4])]:
 sql=f"SELECT {columns} FROM {relation} WHERE {name}=$1"
 r=query(sql.replace('$1',"'"+builtin+"'"));v=text_rows(r);assert len(v)>=1;assert all(x is not None for row in v for x in row)
 d=summary(r)['descriptions'][0];source=2753 if relation=='pg_opfamily' else 2616
 assert [x['oid'] for x in d]==oids;assert [x['attribute'] for x in d]==attrs
 assert all(x['source_oid']==source and x['typmod']==-1 for x in d)
 assert [x['typlen'] for x in d]==[64 if oid==19 else 1 if oid==16 else 4 for oid in oids]
 if relation=='pg_opclass':assert all(row[4]=='0' for row in v)
 check(f"SELECT oid FROM {relation} WHERE {name}='cat14_34_missing'",[])
 denied(f"SELECT missing_column FROM {relation}",'42703')
 send('P',b'op\0'+sql.encode()+b'\0'+struct.pack('!hI',1,25));send('D',b'Sop\0');send('S',b'');r=ready();print('Parse/Describe',json.dumps(summary(r)));assert not summary(r)['errors']
 for value in [builtin.encode(),b'cat14_34_missing',None]:
  for fmt in [0,1]:
   parameter=struct.pack('!i',-1) if value is None else struct.pack('!i',len(value))+value
   send('B',b'p\0op\0'+struct.pack('!hh',0,1)+parameter+struct.pack('!hh',1,fmt));send('D',b'Pp\0');send('E',b'p\0'+struct.pack('!i',0));send('S',b'');r=ready();print('Execute',value,fmt,json.dumps(summary(r)));assert bool(rows(r))==(value==builtin.encode());assert summary(r)['ready']==['I'];assert not summary(r)['errors']
```

#### cat14_35-stage.sh

```text
#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail
mkdir -p target/rust-slot-locks
slot=""
for n in {1..10}; do
 if mkdir "target/rust-slot-locks/slot-$n.lock" 2>/dev/null; then slot=$n; break; fi
done
if [ -z "$slot" ]; then echo 'all slots occupied'; exit 75; fi
lock="$PWD/target/rust-slot-locks/slot-$slot.lock"
printf 'plan=catalog14 task=35 session=cat14_35 PID=%s\n' "$$" > "$lock/owner"
trap 'rm -f "$lock/owner"; rmdir "$lock"' EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$PWD/target/rust-slot-$slot"
echo "slot=$slot CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$CARGO_TARGET_DIR PID=$$"
"$@"
result=$?
echo "exit=$result"
exit "$result"
```

#### cat14_35_reference.sh

```text
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
bin=$1
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/cat14_35-reference.XXXXXX)
cleanup() {
 if [ -f "$tmp/data/postmaster.pid" ]; then "$bin/pg_ctl" -D "$tmp/data" -m fast -w stop >/dev/null; fi
 test ! -f "$tmp/data/postmaster.pid"
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 echo 'cleanup: own reference cluster stopped and removed'
}
trap cleanup EXIT
"$bin/postgres" --version
"$bin/pg_config"
"$bin/psql" --version
python3 --version
"$bin/initdb" -D "$tmp/data" --no-locale --encoding=UTF8 --auth-local=trust --auth-host=reject > "$tmp/initdb.log"
"$bin/pg_ctl" -D "$tmp/data" -o "-k $tmp -h '' -p 56875" -l "$tmp/server.log" -w start >/dev/null
export REFERENCE_BIN="$bin" PGHOST="$tmp" PGPORT=56875 PGDATABASE=postgres
"$bin/psql" -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
SELECT version(); SHOW server_version_num; SHOW server_encoding;
CREATE ROLE cat14_35_reader LOGIN;
CREATE ROLE cat14_35_owner LOGIN;
GRANT USAGE,CREATE ON SCHEMA public TO cat14_35_owner;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO cat14_35_reader;
SET ROLE cat14_35_owner;
CREATE TABLE public.cat14_35_t(id integer);
INSERT INTO public.cat14_35_t VALUES(1);
GRANT SELECT ON public.cat14_35_t TO cat14_35_reader;
RESET ROLE;
SQL
python3 /tmp/cat14_35_reference_wire.py
```

```text
import socket,struct,os,json
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect(os.path.join(os.environ['PGHOST'],'.s.PGSQL.'+os.environ['PGPORT']))
def exact(n):
 b=b''
 while len(b)<n:
  part=s.recv(n-len(b))
  if not part: raise RuntimeError('EOF')
  b+=part
 return b
def read():
 tag=exact(1).decode();n=struct.unpack('!I',exact(4))[0];return tag,exact(n-4)
def send(tag,b):s.sendall(tag.encode()+struct.pack('!I',len(b)+4)+b)
def ready():
 out=[]
 while True:
  msg=read();out.append(msg)
  if msg[0]=='Z':return out
body=struct.pack('!I',196608)+"user\0cat14_35_reader\0database\0postgres\0\0".encode()
s.sendall(struct.pack('!I',len(body)+4)+body)
assert not any(t=='E' for t,b in ready())
def describe(b):
 n=struct.unpack('!h',b[:2])[0];out=[];i=2
 for _ in range(n):
  end=b.index(0,i);name=b[i:end].decode();i=end+1
  fields=struct.unpack('!IhIhih',b[i:i+18]);i+=18
  out.append(dict(zip(['name','source_oid','attribute','oid','typlen','typmod','format'],[name,*fields])))
 return out
def values(b):
 n=struct.unpack('!h',b[:2])[0];out=[];i=2
 for _ in range(n):
  size=struct.unpack('!i',b[i:i+4])[0];i+=4
  out.append(None if size<0 else b[i:i+size].hex());i+=max(size,0)
 return out

def summary(messages):
 return {'tags': ''.join(t for t,b in messages), 'descriptions':[describe(b) for t,b in messages if t=='T'], 'rows':[values(b) for t,b in messages if t=='D'], 'errors':[{part[:1].decode():part[1:].decode() for part in b.split(b'\0') if part} for t,b in messages if t=='E'], 'ready':[b.decode() for t,b in messages if t=='Z']}
def query(sql):
 send('Q',sql.encode()+b'\0');r=ready();print(sql,json.dumps(summary(r),ensure_ascii=False));return r


import subprocess
bin=os.environ['REFERENCE_BIN']
def admin(sql):
 subprocess.run([bin+'/psql','-X','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-U',os.environ.get('USER','xiangmin'),'-c',sql],check=True)
def rows(r): return [values(b) for t,b in r if t=='D']

def text_rows(r): return [[None if v is None else bytes.fromhex(v).decode() for v in row] for row in rows(r)]
def check(sql,expected):
 r=query(sql);assert text_rows(r)==expected,(sql,text_rows(r),expected);assert summary(r)['ready']==['I'];return r
def denied(sql,state,status='I'):
 r=query(sql);assert summary(r)['errors'][0]['C']==state;assert summary(r)['ready']==[status];assert not rows(r)




family=text_rows(query("SELECT f.oid FROM pg_opfamily f JOIN pg_am a ON f.opfmethod=a.oid WHERE f.opfname='integer_ops' AND a.amname='btree'"))[0][0]
for relation,name,columns,oids,attrs,source in [
 ('pg_amop','amopfamily','oid,amopfamily,amopstrategy,amopopr,amopsortfamily',[26,26,21,26,26],[1,2,5,7,9],2602),
 ('pg_amproc','amprocfamily','oid,amprocfamily,amprocnum,amproc,amproclefttype,amprocrighttype',[26,26,21,24,26,26],[1,2,5,6,3,4],2603)]:
 builtin=family
 sql=f"SELECT {columns} FROM {relation} WHERE {name}=$1"
 r=query(sql.replace('$1',builtin));v=text_rows(r);assert len(v)>=1;assert all(x is not None for row in v for x in row)
 assert all(row[1]==family and 1<=int(row[2])<=32767 for row in v)
 d=summary(r)['descriptions'][0]
 assert [x['oid'] for x in d]==oids;assert [x['attribute'] for x in d]==attrs
 assert all(x['source_oid']==source and x['typmod']==-1 for x in d)
 assert [x['typlen'] for x in d]==[2 if oid==21 else 4 for oid in oids]
 check(f"SELECT oid FROM {relation} WHERE {name}=0",[])
 check(f"SELECT oid FROM {relation} WHERE {name} IS NULL",[])
 denied(f"SELECT missing_column FROM {relation}",'42703')
 r=query(f"SELECT xmin FROM {relation} LIMIT 1");assert summary(r)['descriptions'][0][0]['oid']==28
 send('P',b'op\0'+sql.encode()+b'\0'+struct.pack('!hI',1,26));send('D',b'Sop\0');send('S',b'');r=ready();print('Parse/Describe',json.dumps(summary(r)));assert not summary(r)['errors']
 for value in [builtin.encode(),b'0',None]:
  for fmt in [0,1]:
   parameter=struct.pack('!i',-1) if value is None else struct.pack('!i',len(value))+value
   send('B',b'p\0op\0'+struct.pack('!hh',0,1)+parameter+struct.pack('!hh',1,fmt));send('D',b'Pp\0');send('E',b'p\0'+struct.pack('!i',0));send('S',b'');r=ready();print('Execute',value,fmt,json.dumps(summary(r)));assert bool(rows(r))==(value==builtin.encode());assert summary(r)['ready']==['I'];assert not summary(r)['errors']
   desc=summary(r)['descriptions'][0];assert [x['oid'] for x in desc]==oids;assert all(x['format']==fmt for x in desc)
   send('C',b'Pp\0');send('S',b'');ready()
 send('C',b'Sop\0');send('S',b'');ready()
r=query("SELECT a.oid,a.amopfamily,a.amopopr,a.amoplefttype,a.amoprighttype FROM pg_amop a JOIN pg_opfamily f ON a.amopfamily=f.oid JOIN pg_operator o ON a.amopopr=o.oid JOIN pg_type l ON a.amoplefttype=l.oid JOIN pg_type r ON a.amoprighttype=r.oid WHERE f.opfname='integer_ops'")
assert rows(r) and all(all(v is not None for v in row) for row in rows(r))
r=query("SELECT a.oid,a.amprocfamily,a.amproc,a.amproclefttype,a.amprocrighttype FROM pg_amproc a JOIN pg_opfamily f ON a.amprocfamily=f.oid JOIN pg_proc p ON a.amproc=p.oid JOIN pg_type l ON a.amproclefttype=l.oid JOIN pg_type r ON a.amprocrighttype=r.oid WHERE f.opfname='integer_ops'")
assert rows(r) and all(all(v is not None for v in row) for row in rows(r))
r=query('BEGIN');assert summary(r)['ready']==['T'];denied('SELECT missing_column FROM pg_opfamily','42703','E');denied('SELECT 1','25P02','E');check('ROLLBACK',[]);check('SELECT 1',[['1']])
send('X',b'');s.close()
admin('DROP TABLE public.cat14_35_t; DROP OWNED BY cat14_35_reader; DROP ROLE cat14_35_reader; DROP OWNED BY cat14_35_owner; DROP ROLE cat14_35_owner;')
print('reference assertions passed; nonroot; family member identities; int2 strategy/procnum; xid xmin; text/binary/NULL; recovery; cleanup')
```
